events.text: The stairs to your door have become steeper, somehow, every year.

effects.log: One step at a time. The view from the top is still yours.
A carpenter builds it. You pretend it is for guests.

events.text: You walk into a room and forget why. It happens more often now.

effects.log: You remember later. It was for the tea.
You practise remembering. It helps a little.

events.text: A young martial artist travels a long way just to ask you about a fight you had forty years ago.

effects.log: It was messier and less heroic than the legend. The young one is thrilled anyway.
The young one goes home with a better story than yours.

events.text: You visit the graves of friends. There are more of them than there used to be.

effects.log: You tell each friend the news. It takes all day.

choices.text: Pour wine for the one you miss most

effects.log: You finish the jug together, in a way.

events.text: You can no longer eat hard rice cakes. Your favourite food, lost.

effects.log: Soggy but delicious. Victory.
You write a poem to rice cakes. It is very moving.

events.text: Your knees predict the rain now, more accurately than the farmers.

choices.text: Offer weather forecasts to the village

effects.log: You are more accurate than the fortune teller. She is annoyed.
A week of warm water. The knees forgive you, briefly.

events.text: Your sword feels heavier than it did. Not much. Enough.

effects.log: A lighter blade, a wiser hand.

choices.text: Keep training with the old one

effects.log: Heavy, familiar, yours.

events.text: The children in the courtyard are loud. You find you do not mind any more.

effects.log: Twenty children, one story, total silence.
The best nap of your life, full of laughter.

events.text: A letter from an old rival, now also very old: 'I still think I would have won.'

effects.log: You meet. Neither of you can fight any more. You laugh instead.
He replies with one word: "Liar." You smile for a week.

events.text: A young relative asks what you want people to remember about you.

effects.log: They write it down. You hope it is true.
They write it down. Strength fades; stories do not.

events.text: Your morning walk is shorter than it was. The birds are the same.

effects.log: It takes twice as long. You see twice as much.

choices.text: Sit on the bench and listen

effects.log: The birds come closer when you are still.

events.text: Reading has become harder. The characters swim.

effects.log: A child reads you the classics every evening. You teach each other.

choices.text: Buy reading glasses from a foreign trader

effects.log: Strange glass circles. They work.

events.text: A young master challenges you, hoping to make his name on your old bones.

ok.log: One move. He sits in the dust. You go home and sleep for two days.

fail.log: He wins. He bows very low. You are proud of him anyway.

effects.log: He listens. It is worth more than a win.

events.text: Four generations at one table. You are at the head of it.

effects.log: It is too long. Nobody minds.
You watch everyone you made. It is enough.

events.text: The winter feels longer this year. The cold settles into your bones.

effects.log: Warm and slow. You get through it.

choices.text: Circulate your qi through the cold nights

effects.log: Your energy keeps you warm. Old techniques, still useful.

events.text: You decide it is time to give your sword to someone who will use it.

choices.text: Give it to a promising young stranger

effects.log: They will never know what it means. They will learn.
It stays in the family. It carries your hand in it.

events.text: A physician tells you to stop training so hard 'at your age'.

effects.log: You train gently. You feel better.
You train as always. Your body complains loudly.

events.text: You hear your own story told in the market, forty years later, with the wrong ending.

effects.log: The crowd prefers the wrong ending.
Legends belong to the people telling them.

events.text: One evening you realise you are not angry at anyone any more.

effects.log: It is very light.
Some are answered. Some are to the dead.

events.text: Your birthday. The whole village brings longevity noodles, the longest noodles anyone has made.

effects.log: A long life, by tradition. You succeed, messily.
Long noodles, long table, long evening.
